Q1: What should happen to the "remaining scope" (review/codex-agent stays red while the Claude account pool has no credential; refreshing the pool credentials)?
Choices:
A) Treat #10018 as complete and close it. Both items were declared out of scope in the original specification, and refreshing the pool is an operator credential task. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Close #10018 and open a separate ordinary issue to change code so review/codex-agent fails clearly, or is skipped with a neutral result, when the Claude account pool has no credential, instead of failing the review run. The pool refresh stays an operator task.
C) Keep #10018 open and widen its scope to cover the code change in B here. This needs a new `files_touched` grant beyond the current plan grant, which covers only `scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh`, tests, changelog and agents fragments. **Note:** the current grant does not cover the reviewer scripts (e.g. `scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh`), so the plan would be held again unless the grant is widened.
